about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer who believes in building software from first principles. My work spans distributed systems in Rust to fluid animations in React — I care deeply about performance, architecture, and the craft of code.
When I'm not architecting systems or shipping features, you'll find me writing about compilers, protocols, and the timeless principles that make great software.
